name: app-dialog
title: AppDialog (static helpers: confirm, alert)

static_helpers: static Future<bool?> confirm(BuildContext context, {required String title, required String message, String cancelLabel = "Cancelar", String confirmLabel = "Confirmar", bool isDestructive = false})
static Future<void> alert(BuildContext context, {required String title, required String message, String okLabel = "OK", IconData? icon})

conventions_reminder: class AppDialog with private constructor AppDialog._()
All colors/spacings/radii via tokens — no hardcoded values
Double quotes on all string literals
Top-of-file doc comment explaining purpose + state behavior
acceptance_criteria: confirm() returns Future<bool?> (true for confirm, false for cancel, null for dismissed)
Destructive confirm uses AppColors.error for confirm button
